claims.claim: Honestly, that dip is a blip on a page to most of us. Teacher quality at 9.08 — that's the number my staff feels every single day, in the hallways, in the way a kid who was struggling suddenly gets it. The index is a snapshot; the teachers are the whole album. We don't walk around quoting our own score. We walk around making sure every kid in this building knows someone's got their back. That's the real index, and it doesn't move a tenth of a point because of a cycle.
